mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_auth_feishu_role_mapping ( rule_type, subject_id, subject_name, grant_kind, role_code, scope_type, scope_value, priority, decision_status, description, created_by ) VALUES ( #{ruleType}, #{subjectId}, #{subjectName}, #{grantKind}, #{roleCode}, #{scopeType}, #{scopeValue}, #{priority}, 'DRAFT', #{description}, #{createdBy} )
mapper.update: UPDATE t_auth_feishu_role_mapping SET rule_type = #{ruleType}, subject_id = #{subjectId}, subject_name = #{subjectName}, grant_kind = #{grantKind}, role_code = #{roleCode}, scope_type = #{scopeType}, scope_value = #{scopeValue}, priority = #{priority}, description = #{description}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND decision_status = 'DRAFT'
